amendment.internal: Private implementation of s10: Fall back to a diff-only degraded review when the index cannot be made fresh

body.rationale: Extends Epic `add-daemon-driven-code-review-stage` (761a43a6) — Story B of the Fix-C pair (sibling of s9). Builds the diff-only degraded-review fallback on the s9 gate (src/mcp/code-review-step/handler.ts, src/workflow/code-review/{runner,grounding,types,subject}.ts) and folds in the working-tree-diff changedFiles fix surfaced by the s9 dogfood.

citations.quotedText: Approved SpecArtifact SPEC-8b4be30d648eaeb8 decisions d5 (diff-only fallback on decline) + d6 (groundingMode:'degraded' + warn-cap) — the settled scope this story implements.
s9 stamps groundingMode:'full' and fails closed on decline; the LLD explicitly notes Story B replaces that fail-closed exit + widens groundingMode to 'full' | 'degraded'.
resolveCodeReviewSubject derives changedFiles from the working-tree git_diff — empty after commit (the dogfood finding s10 folds in).
